title: Bitmark-era storage enumerated
body: Published the complete list of works whose only copy is on Feral File's CDN: 4,959 works across 215 series in 17 exhibitions, all minted on the Bitmark blockchain before Feral File moved to Ethereum and Tezos. Every series' media was checked and currently resolves. Remediation — a content-addressed copy for every work — is targeted within 2 to 3 months. The full census of Ethereum and Tezos works is running and publishes here when it completes.
